ROLE_NOT_FOUND: The role does not exist or has been deleted
PARENT_ROLE_NOT_FOUND: The parent role does not exist or has been deleted
ROLE_HAS_RELATIONS: Remove the role's users and child roles before deleting it
ROLE_HIERARCHY_CYCLE: The role hierarchy cannot contain a cycle
USER_NOT_FOUND: The user does not exist or has been deleted
ASSIGNMENT_EXISTS: The user already has this role
ASSIGNMENT_NOT_FOUND: The user does not have this role
